methodology.crps: Empirical ensemble CRPS; fair CRPS additionally corrects finite iid sample bias. Average within each cast, then equally across casts. No calibration; all 102 Italian XBT casts.
methodology.lpips: Pretrained LPIPS 0.1 VGG16, each depth repeated across RGB; fixed [-2,35] Celsius clipped/scaled to [-1,1]. Common wet mask, identical zero fill, spatial distances averaged over wet pixels eroded 16 cells. Exploratory natural-image metric against packaged GLORYS, not XBT accuracy. Average members, depths, then patches.
methodology.spectra: Physical temperature fields, plane detrending, 2D Hann window, window-energy-normalized FFT power, 32 logarithmic wavelength bins 30–1000 km. Physical spacing at patch center; common wet mask with zero residual fill. Average member power before patch averaging. Spectral score is log10-power RMSE against GLORYS with a common 1e-12 °C² power floor, then equal depth and patch weights; lower is better.
methodology.support: CRPS and spatial comparisons: all 14 Italian patches / 102 casts. Identical patch/depth/mask support across spatial methods. No EN4 cohort changes.
methodology.uncertainty: 90% intervals are sample 5th–95th percentiles. Two missions do not support robust significance claims; discovery-year evaluation.
